Name: Asian Cuisine - Vietnamese Foods

Description:
☆ Hey everyone this is my 1st mod (images and objects are made by me).

☆ More items / image changes will be added if requested.

☆ It works with the newest Stardew version and there's no known mod conflicts yet.

Instructions: 
1. Download json assets and unzip that to your mod folder
2. Download my mod and unzip that to your mod folder
3. Purchase all recipes from Gus (saloon). All recipes can be made with vanilla ingredients for ease. Powerful in game buffs.
